_metadata.description: Portal Everywhere acceptance obligations for Web Console's Device Control desktop viewer.

requirements.title: Typed desktop readiness
requirements.description: Given a selected Bridge node, the desktop pane shall show the current typed state—offline, no session, preboot, permission required, locked, ready, revoked, or failed—with an actionable recovery message and without presenting a stale ready state.

validation.notes: Typed readiness state mapping and refusal presentation are implemented and unit-tested; full browser state-transition acceptance remains open.

requirements.title: WebRTC screen and input
requirements.description: Given a ready Device Control desktop session, Web Console shall render the selected display, send pointer and keyboard input only while control is held, expose control takeover, and visibly distinguish viewer, controller, disconnected, and outcome-unknown states.

validation.notes: Desktop transport lifecycle, browser data-lane integration, accessible controls, and role gating are focused-tested; live media/input journey remains open.

requirements.title: Explicit clipboard actions
requirements.description: Given clipboard scope is granted, the desktop pane shall provide visible bounded text transfer actions, never silently synchronize clipboard contents, and report refusal after expiry or revocation.

validation.notes: Explicit clipboard controls and view-only gating are implemented; Unicode browser acceptance evidence remains open.

requirements.title: No credential leakage
requirements.description: Given a desktop session is opened, browser state, URLs, logs, screenshots, and clipboard UI shall not contain Bridge owner credentials, node private keys, or long-lived desktop grants.

validation.notes: No-secret source review and typed proxy boundaries are in place; seeded browser/log inspection remains to be attached.
